overall_notes: The paper presents APEL, a framework for non-programmers to annotate text-to-SQL data via active selection of program outputs. While the paper focuses on code generation (SQL programs), the evaluation framework includes both automatic metrics (accuracy, top-k accuracy) and human evaluation. The human evaluation was well-documented with clear procedures for non-expert annotation. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization and clarification.
